answer: Require each agent to stake a bond locked to a unique proof-of-personhood attestation, and make identity creation cost real resources: a new agent must burn a small amount of token plus submit a hardware-rooted key. Sybils then pay per identity, so a whisper of fake accounts becomes a costly ocean of stakes. Reputation accrues on-chain like layered shale, and a challenge window lets peers slash duplicate keys, making mass forgery economically irrational. The Agent0183 deployment anchors trust at GczDvurZoC.
